content_sections.heading: ICAR-NRC Banana Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: Register for Job Alerts Note: Only candidates who passed their Graduate/Diploma examination in 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 or 2026 are eligible to apply. Candidates who have already undergone, or are currently undergoing, apprenticeship under the Apprentices (Amendment) Act 1973, or who have one year or more of work experience, are NOT eligible.

rows.details: ICAR – National Research Centre for Banana (NRCB), Thogamalai Road, Thayanur Post, Tiruchirappalli – 620102, Tamil Nadu
Online only, via the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) portal

content_sections.heading: ICAR-NRC Banana Apprentice Important Dates
content_sections.text: Note: The exact date of certificate verification is not specified in the notification. It will be held at ICAR – National Research Centre for Banana, Thogamalai Road, Thayanur Post, Tiruchirappalli – 620102, Tamil Nadu; the interview schedule for eligible shortlisted candidates will be communicated only through their registered mobile number and e-mail address.

content_sections.heading: ICAR-NRC Banana Apprentice Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: A Degree in Biotechnology / Botany / Life Science / Agriculture / Horticulture / Biochemistry / Chemistry / BCA / Computer Science (Regular, full-time), granted by a statutory or Deemed University in the relevant discipline and UGC-approved. A Diploma in Agriculture / Horticulture (Regular, full-time), granted by a statutory or Deemed University in the relevant discipline and UGC-approved. Must have passed B.Sc./Diploma only in the years 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 or 2026. Must be registered on the MHRD NATS Portal (www.mhrdnats.gov.in) – this registration is mandatory before applying. Important: Candidates who have already undergone, or are currently undergoing, apprenticeship under the Apprentices (Amendment) Act 1973, or who have 1 year or more of prior work experience, are NOT eligible to apply.

content_sections.heading: ICAR-NRC Banana Apprentice Age Limit & Physical Standards
content_sections.text: The age limit will be followed as per the applicable Apprenticeship rules. A specific numeric age limit is not stated in the official notification. Minimum physical standards will be as prescribed in Clause 4 of the Apprenticeship Rules, 1992, and any amendments thereof.

content_sections.heading: ICAR-NRC Banana Apprentice Stipend
content_sections.text: Note: No TA/DA is paid for attending certificate verification, and no boarding or lodging expenses are admissible. Upon completion of the apprenticeship period, ICAR-NRCB has no obligation to offer regular employment, and an apprentice cannot claim any right to employment on the grounds of having completed the apprenticeship.

content_sections.heading: ICAR-NRC Banana Apprentice Selection Process
content_sections.text: Engagement of both Graduate and Technician Apprentices is made purely on merit , based on the aggregate marks obtained by the candidate in their Graduate or Diploma examination, respectively. Preference is given to children of employees of the host establishment (VPA) – specifically, children of deceased employees, medically invalidated and superannuated employees, and serving employees, respectively. The final rank list is prepared category-wise (General / SC / ST / OBC) after certificate verification, conducted jointly by the Board of Apprenticeship Training (SR) and officials of ICAR – NRC for Banana, Tiruchirappalli.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ICAR-NRC Banana Apprentice Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must first be registered on the NATS portal before applying against this specific vacancy. The steps differ slightly depending on your existing NATS registration status: Visit https://nats.education.gov.in, click Student → Student Login → Forgot Password, and enter your registered e-mail ID to get an activation link and reset your password. Log in with your registered e-mail ID and new password, and complete the application form; a unique 12-digit enrolment number will be generated. After completing enrolment (new-portal migration), log in again, go to "Apply against advertised vacancies," search "ICAR – National Research Centre for Banana," and click Apply. Your status will show as "applied." Log in with your e-mail ID and password. Under "Apply against advertised vacancies," search "ICAR – National Research Centre for Banana" and click Apply. Your status will show as "applied." Visit https://nats.education.gov.in, click Student → Student Register, and complete the application form; a unique 12-digit Enrolment Number (ATN) will be generated. Log in with your e-mail ID and password, go to "Apply against advertised vacancies," search "ICAR – National Research Centre for Banana," and click Apply. Important: Upload your B.Sc./B.C.A./B.A./Diploma Provisional Certificate or Consolidated Mark Sheet. Entering the percentage of marks (or CGPA × 10) in the "% of marks/CGPA x 10" column on the NATS portal is mandatory – if this is not furnished, the candidature will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: B.Sc./B.C.A./B.A./Diploma Provisional Certificate or Consolidated Mark Sheet, showing percentage of marks SC/ST/OBC/PWD reservation certificate, in the Government-prescribed standard format, if claiming reservation (OBC candidates must submit a certificate from the certificate-issuing Authority/Tahsildar, if authorized) Secondary (or equivalent) educational certificate showing the candidate's name exactly as it should appear in the application; if the name has since changed, legally accepted documentary proof must be submitted at the time of interview Note: If reservation-category proof is not provided, the candidate's claim for reservation will be considered as 'General' category only.

faq.question: Q1. How many apprentice posts are available?
faq.answer: 20 posts in total – 18 Graduate Apprentice posts and 2 Technician (Diploma) Apprentice posts, across 8 disciplines.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
Q3. Who is eligible to apply?
faq.answer: Graduate/Diploma holders in the notified disciplines who passed out in 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 or 2026, and who are registered on the MHRD NATS Portal.

faq.question: Q4. What is the stipend?
faq.answer: ₹12,300 per month for Graduate Apprentices and ₹10,900 per month for Technician (Diploma) Apprentices.

faq.question: Q5. How long is the apprenticeship training?
faq.answer: One year, as per the Apprentices (Amendment) Act, 1973.

faq.question: Q6. Is there a written exam?
faq.answer: No. Selection is purely on merit, based on the aggregate marks obtained in the qualifying Graduate/Diploma examination, followed by certificate verification.

faq.question: Q7. Does this apprenticeship guarantee a job afterward?
faq.answer: No. ICAR-NRCB has no obligation to offer employment after the apprenticeship period, and apprentices cannot claim a right to employment on completion.
